BREAKING: Inventories in the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve fell by ~800,000 barrels last week, to 283.8 million barrels, the lowest level since 1982.

This marks the 27th consecutive weekly decline, putting inventories down more than -132 million barrels from their high.
